article.headline: Ahayere’s 24 lead Colgate over Penn State-Behrend 87-55
article.description: — Josh Ahayere had 24 points in Colgate’s 87-55 win against Penn State-Behrend on Saturday.
article.linkText: Ahayere’s 24 lead Colgate over Penn State-Behrend 87-55

categories.description: Penn State Behrend Lions @ Colgate Raiders

event.description: Penn State Behrend Lions @ Colgate Raiders

keywords: Penn State Behrend Lions @ Colgate Raiders
article.story: HAMILTON, N.Y. -- — Josh Ahayere had 24 points in Colgate’s 87-55 win against Penn State-Behrend on Saturday. Ahayere had five rebounds for the Raiders (2-4). Andrew Alekseyenko scored 16 points and added six rebounds and seven assists. Parker Jones shot 4 for 8, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc to finish with 12 points. Drew Hind led the Behrend Lions in scoring, finishing with 17 points. Penn State-Behrend also got 14 points and eight rebounds from Jacob Dunkle. Nate Edwards finished with 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
